title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing grant and scope validation to be performed under that other client identity. This affects the client_credentials and password grant flows. An attacker with credentials for a low-privilege client can obtain tokens with the privileges of a higher-privilege client if the application validator authorizes based on the attacker-supplied client_id argument. This is an authorization bypass requiring valid client credentials.
